name: EV backend
install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && cd backend && $HOME/.local/bin/uv sync --extra s3 --extra dev

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: EV FastAPI dev server with offline zero-setup defaults (SQLite, sync processing, hash embeddings, local object storage). Web workbench at /app, health at /v1/health, OpenAPI docs at /docs. Auth uses the default master key 'ev-local-dev-key'.
